title: Busboy shifts at the Crown
summary: Race the clock clearing glasses and delivering drinks for a $10 bar prize.
notes: Use the busboy station at the left end of the salon bar to start a two-minute shift.
Carry one empty glass back at a time from the three card tables and east lounge table.
Take ordered drinks from the bar to marked seated patrons as spawn rates increase.
Survive without nine dirty glasses or a late order, finish all orders and return to claim $10.
